text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we somehow made it this far. To 
the GⅠ Zen-Nippon Nisai Yushun...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The pinnacle showdown for Junior Class 
dirt Umamusume. Today, top contenders from 
the JRA are also participating.
choice_data_list: Ah, but with Furioso's sense, it'll work!

Yeah, but with Furioso's instincts, you 
can do it!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it will reach them, even on 
this grand stage.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go into this with confidence!
Yeah, let's go in with confidence!

text_block_list.text:
While they're still inexperienced 
Junior-class runners, racing sense matters 
above all else. In that regard...

Furioso has outstanding racing sense. I'm 
sure she'll put on a great performance 
here too.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll believe in 
myself and go for it! Just...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even if you feel that way, Trainer, the 
racing fans might not see it the same way.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Do your best! Show 'em the power of the 
Tracen Center!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right! We're counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(As expected, the Central Umamusume have 
more fame and higher expectations. But...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Fame and substance are two different 
things. Even if nobody cheers for me...)
Beat 'em down, Furioso!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that voice...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare lose! Beat 'em all to a 
pulp and turn 'em into Kawasaki scrap 
metal!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Furi, Furi, Furiri♪ LOVE YOU, Furio-!
choice_data_list: Why are you two cheering for me...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't cheerin' you on or nothin'. If 
there's a brawl, of course I'm gonna come 
egg ya on!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's an important race for you, 
Furioso-san. Of course I was going to 
come.

They are URA Umamusume. Even so, this 
kindness really touches the heart.
And not just the two of them, but...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Furi-chan, do your best~

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: That's right~, fight on~.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: K-Kinda... to cheer you on, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
After thinking it through, I really feel 
like Furi-chan is the true representative 
of Funabashi.
Furioso doesn't say much. Even so—

Her deep love for Funabashi was clearly 
conveyed through her attitude.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Falcon-san... Espo-san... And Samin and 
Myu too...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I have people cheering for me too... In 
that case—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I can't lose, not after all that!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even as an Umamusume from Funabashi, I 
want to show what I'm capable of! 
Absolutely!
